It's hours before the first assault is planned to be launched on these "Deva." Months of preparation have led up to this moment. Roughly 1000 Sophons have gathered in the staging area before the portal to this strange "in-between" land; each Sophon there knew that the Deva possessed devices capable of killing at least one of them alone and knew that they may not come back.

"Every one ready yourselves!" The High Commander spoke the orders to those assembled through their comms stone.

The High Commander saw fit to send a scouting party of 3 Sophons through first to asses the Devite defenses.

The scouting party went through.

Hours passed waiting for them to return with information.

Finally they came through with different information than expected.

"Sir, the mountain is besieged by some kind of large creature that is spewing thousands of foot soldiers into the mountain and surrounding area. It looks like the beasts Xeos described a few weeks ago!"

The Commander pondered this information for a moment thinking to himself, "maybe we don't send troops to combat the Deva and, instead, send more troops to help fight these creatures at the 'Tree of Life'."

He then contacted Gaellor explaining what has been found and his plan.

The Gaellor council approved and 700 Sophons were sent to the Tree of Life.

#####They don't yet know about it being burned because Xeos has been conserving his energy so he doesn't burn up as well as repairing his armor after the move to the island.

----------

Ever since the Sophons set foot on the surface, they had noticed a certain peculiarity happening with their electronics. [](#s "Electronics being things like the amplifiers and lighting systems.")

Every now and then, as amplifiers, lights, or cannons were being built, the wires would occasionally emit sparks even when not hooked up to a battery. An even more worrisome development was when one builder was having trouble with his alterations to an amplifier and it spontaneously caught on fire! The researchers were baffled for weeks as to how such a thing could happen when one did not use the Corgi to do so. After the fire, a whole team was created to learn about this force that caused it. Many methods were tried; some waved stones around, because many tools are made of shaped stone, while others waved their hands around while wearing cloves of cloth, because the engineers wear cloth cloves while they work. Many other methods were tested but, none of these proved fruitful in the least.

Three weeks into researching this phenomena, a breakthrough was made. One researcher found that, if gloves had metal wire woven into them, they would sometimes produce small arks of electricity or fire. Next she tried taking just wire and waving it around. This produced similar effects. Other researchers tried doing the same and each got different results. Over the next few weeks it was discovered that by bending the wires 'just so' would produce flames from the end. All the moss was then burned from the outsides of the research lab and surrounding buildings because the researchers became a little too excited about their discovery. They were not aloud to wave their wires around in town for 3 months after.

The researchers learned how to consistently make electricity using this energy and began working out how it might be possible to use this to charge batteries. Months were spent working out how to effectively use this energy to shoot electricity into the battery. Batteries were simply zapped by the researchers and violently exploded. Others were connected to bare wires and the wires were zapped. More explosions. Finally someone had the idea to take a charger, remove the inner windings, and zap the remaining windings. This was very effective. No explosions, no meltdowns. The battery charged.

Now to make it small enough to put in a suit so there was no need to carry a separate charger at all.

This would take more time because the current configuration of wires was quite a large contraption.

----------

The two groups sent to help defend the Tree of Life had decided it smarter to meet up and join the fighting all at once so that there may be less losses if any. Travel had taken longer than hopped because they could not use gliders for, there were not enough for a group this large and even with the gliders, the range on the cannons were not far enough to reach the tree.

They had begun to fell the ground shake and a large commotion when the High Commander informed them of the developments with the war effort and what the scouts found. Many in the reinforcement party were shocked. There was another of these beasts?!

The whole of the reinforcements cooled off in a nearby creek and began making faster progress toward the fighting, the shaking became more powerful the closer they came.

Each Sophon cleared their minds or everything that could impede their judgment in battle and charged batteries in preparation.

Once every Sophon was ready, 50 drew Accelerator Cannons and 100 drew swords. The strategy discussed amongst them was that there would be 50 groups of one AC gunner guarded by two Blade-Dancers. The strategy was then communicated to the commander as well as that they were to soon enter the battle.

Once the last battery was charged, one hundred and fifty Sophons leaped into battle.

Decided not to send troops to the Deva
